name: Font Cloud Server
description: Cloud font subsetting for embedded UI: take a run of dynamic text, return a minimal TTF subset. Fixed UI strings are preset at build time; this tool serves dynamic glyphs (lyrics / notes / novels) on demand.
description_zh: 面向嵌入式 UI 的字体云端子集化：输入一段动态文本，返回仅含所需汉字的子集 TTF。固定界面文案构建期预置；本工具只负责动态文本缺字。
canonical_url_hint: Share the full base URL including the path /font-cloud

body.chars: string (required) whole text run; server dedupes

subset.cache_semantics: key = font_id + sorted(unique chars); order and duplicates do not matter; HIT returns identical bytes

invariants: Fixed UI text is subset at build time (offline)
Dynamic text: request missing glyphs per paragraph
One TTF subset shared across sizes (no px)
Local LittleFS cache + memory index on device (leg B)
